channel.description: Latest articles from The Christian Post (christianpost.com)

item.title: Somali family facing death penalty for putting faith in Jesus forced to flee home
item.description: A mother of three in Somalia fled her home after her Muslim husband learned she had accepted Christ, but he later also converted and now the entire family is at risk, they said. #Somalia #persecution #Islam

item.title: TikTok video leads to arrest of alleged human smuggler charging $100 per immigrant
item.description: A TikTok video has led immigration authorities to a suspect accused of smuggling illegal immigrants, with the man admitting that he had previously transported 10 undocumented individuals. #BorderPatrol #humansmuggling #TikTok #illegalimmigration #immigrationpolicies

item.title: Wiley Drake, politically outspoken former SBC vice president, dies at 82
item.description: Wiley Drake, a politically outspoken pastor and former vice president of the Southern Baptist Convention known for his advocacy for the poor, has died at the age of 82. #WileyDrake #SBC #Baptists #vicepresident #Obama #California #obituary

item.title: Illinois school accused of unlawfully banning Christian Good News clubs: lawsuit
item.description: An Illinois school district has been accused of mistreating Good News Club chapters by imposing stricter access restrictions than those for secular student clubs. #Illinois #GoodNewsClub #ChildEvangelismFellowship #publicschools #education #FirstAmendment

item.title: Female wrestler says male opponent sexually assaulted her, school delayed reporting incident
item.description: High school wrestler Kallie Keeler just wanted the match to end after she was recently forced to compete against a male during a girls' wrestling competition, alleging that her opponent sexually assaulted her when he pinned her to the ground. #womenssports #transathlete #genderidentity #womenswrestling #highschoolsports

item.title: US to send 200 troops to train Nigerian forces to fight Islamic terrorists
item.description: The United States will send 200 troops to Nigeria to train the country’s military to combat Islamist terrorists. The new deployment follows recent U.S. airstrikes and President Donald Trump’s warnings over the Nigerian government’s handling of attacks against Christians. #ChristiansinNigeria #ChristianPersecution #KillingofChristians #PresidentTrump #BokoHaram #Fulani #ISWAP #IslamicStateWestAfricaProvince #USMilitary

item.title: Alabama mulls bill to make disrupting church services a felony
item.description: Alabama lawmakers are considering a bill that, if passed, would make disrupting worship services a felony punishable by up to 10 years in prison. #Alabama #Minnesota #church #worship #FACEAct #felony #FirstAmendment #CitiesChurch

item.title: Canada’s deadliest school shooting leaves 10 dead, over 25 injured
item.description: A shooter opened fire at a high school in western Canada on Tuesday, killing at least nine people and injuring dozens before dying by suicide. The incident marks the deadliest school shooting in the country’s history. #CanadaSchoolShooting #HighSchool #BritishColumbia #TumblerRidgeSecondarySchool

item.title: Assemblies of God executive, Pastor Rod Loy, denies sexual abuse claims made by former youth pastor’s wife
item.description: Assemblies of God Executive Presbyter and Senior Pastor of First Assembly of God in North Little Rock, Arkansas, Rod Loy, has denied allegations made in a recent lawsuit by his former youth and executive pastor’s wife that he sexually abused her for 20 years, beginning when she was just 16. #RodLoy #AssembliesofGod #SuzanneLander #PatrickLander #Lawsuit #SexualAbuse

item.title: Religious Liberty Commission removes member who defended Candace Owens
item.description: A member of the White House Religious Liberty Commission is refusing to resign after she defended Candace Owens and Tucker Carlson during a recent hearing on combating antisemitism, denying that the media personalities have encouraged Jew hatred or promoted Jewish stereotypes. #religiousliberty #antisemitismawareness #CandaceOwens #Zionism #TuckerCarlson
